But who has the best takeout in the state? Like everything else that has been dubbed the¬†‚Äúbest,‚Äù there is often debate.
According to Love Food , the publication crowned the winners of the best takeout food in every state, and for Montana, the best is found in Missoula¬†at Bridge Pizza.
A National Food Site Names Montana‚Äôs Best Takeout This stood out because because¬†it‚Äôs¬†not often that a place shows up on¬†a¬†‚Äúbest of¬†Montana‚Äù¬†list that I have not only tried, but I eat there often.

Missoula's Ultimate Guide to Pizza We asked our listeners about the best pizza places in Missoula. They gave us a list of their favorites. Some have been around for a while, and others are new to the scene. Gallery Credit: Chris Wolfe Chris Wolfe Biga Pizza Biga Pizza , located at 241 W. Main Street, serves up some quality original pies. They have been featured on the Food Network's "Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives". Chris Wolfe The Bridge Pizza The Bridge Pizza has two locations in Missoula: 600 South Higgins in their newly remodeled building and 3000 Brooks Street in the old Tower Pizza location. Chris Wolfe Pie Hole Pie Hole, located at 525 N. Higgins Ave., has become a hot spot for that late-night pizza craving. They are open until 3 am, so if you stay out late, you can always get a slice before heading home. Chris Wolfe The Still Room The Still Room is making an impact on great food. It's located at 1609 W. Broadway in the Broadway Inn. Chris Wolfe Flipper's Casino Flipper's Casino is showing up on a lot of lists of some really good food. Don't let the exterior fool you. They are located at 125 S. 3rd Street West. Chris Wolfe Front Street Pizza Front Street Pizza is a New York-style pizza joint. It's a relatively newer pizza spot, but they are serving up some great pizza, and people are taking notice. They are located at 315 E. Front Street. Chris Wolfe MacKenzie River Pizza MacKenzie River Pizza has two locations in Missoula: 3820 South Reserve Street and 5210 Grant Creek Road. MacKenzie River Pizza started in Bozeman in 1993 and has opened locations in Montana and surrounding states over the years. Chris Wolfe Highlander Brewery Some of the biggest pizzas in town are at Highlander Beer , located at 200 International Drive.
